workflow: Open the exact approved reference sheet and isolate the cell assigned in designs.json.
Recreate/extract that motif as a full transparent canonical source; do not design a new motif.
Normalize the canonical source to the collection 24-color palette.
Verify complete silhouette and safe transparent margins on all four sides.
Only after canonical source approval, derive CS/C2C/TC/LH matrices using the configured grid targets.
Keep product render_ready=false until the canonical source and technique matrices pass visual QA.
qa_reject_if: wrong flower/species or vessel compared with reference
missing major flower, leaf, bow, pot, branch or container
head/top/bottom/side equivalent clipping of any motif component
materially altered pose, arrangement or proportions
